key_patterns: Controller pattern: a *Controller class (RunController in tools/web/run_controller.py) owns one subprocess at a time behind a threading.Lock, spawns `py -3.13 -X utf8 <script>.py` with stdout piped to a daemon drain thread, captures a `RUN_DIR=`-style first-line pointer, and exposes is_running()/start_*()/stop()/get_status(). Status/progress is derived by reading a JSON summary file the subprocess writes atomically (write to `<name>.json.tmp` then `Path.replace()`), plus tailing a `run.log` file — never via IPC. server.py: stdlib http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler subclass, routes dispatched by exact path string in do_GET/do_POST, JSON responses via self._send_json(payload, status), POST bodies parsed via self._read_body() (Content-Length + json.loads, swallow decode errors to {}), file downloads via send_header Content-Disposition. Front end: single index.html with numbered <section class="card"> blocks, app.js uses a bare `$(id)` getElementById helper, fetch-based getJSON/postJSON helpers, a 2-second setInterval poll loop (tick()) that calls /status and re-renders; buttons are disabled/enabled based on guard state; .banner/.hint/.checkbox/.btn-row/.pbar CSS classes already exist in style.css and should be reused, not reinvented. The existing high-risk-approval UX pattern to mirror exactly: index.html's '2. Start today's run' card has a `<label class="checkbox"><input type="checkbox" id="ads-approve"> Approve ADS upload...</label>` plus a `.hint` paragraph explaining the risk, and RunController.start_run(ads_approved: bool) takes that flag and refuses to produce a full/publishable run without it. Dry-run-first pattern precedent: run_daily.py's own summary.json atomic-write (json.dumps + .tmp + .replace) is the model for the new dry-run summary file. Reference write-logic to adapt (NOT copy verbatim): C:\Users\kabideba\Documents\TT_Automation\post_comments.py — Playwright launch_persistent_context on the shared edge_profile, per-URL grouped comments formatted as `TID: {tid} | {remark}` joined with newlines, selectors `#sim-communicationActions--createComment` and `button:has-text('Post to Correspondence')`, a multi-selector visibility+empty-textbox verification loop, and incremental per-ticket report save to an Excel file for crash recovery via same-day Status==Success dedup. The blocking `input()` retry loop in that reference script must be DROPPED (per task spec) in favor of a one-pass run plus a separate operator-triggered retry-failed action.
